summary: Plan IT service recovery with practical BIA, RTO/RPO, dependency mapping and runbook exercises. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: IT disaster recovery and business continuity planning helps continuity coordinators, infrastructure leads and service owners prioritize restoration. Participants practice assessing business impact, mapping service dependencies, setting recovery time and recovery point objectives, sequencing restoration, drafting runbooks, validating backup restores and using tabletop exercises to support consistent recovery decisions.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who plan, operate or validate the restoration of critical IT services and need practical recovery documentation for their teams.
modules: Business Impact Analysis and Service Criticality
prerequisites: Working familiarity with common IT services, infrastructure or business continuity activities will help you contribute to the exercises. No coding or programming is required. The course treats recovery planning at an operational application level; advanced architecture and technical configuration are outside the practical scope.
